title: Settings
help: Site-wide configuration. Each group saves on its own; unsaved edits are kept when you switch groups.

server.title: Node connection
server.help: The token, sync intervals and limits node backends (XrayR / V2bX / soga) use to talk to the panel. Copy-ready config snippets are at the bottom.

email.title: Email
email.help: Verification codes, reminders and notices are sent with these settings; edit their subject and body under “Email templates”.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.help: A Telegram bot pushes order, ticket, sign-in and other alerts to admins; users who link Telegram get their own reminders too.

app_name.label: Site name
app_name.hint: Used in page titles, emails and subscription file names.

app_description.label: Site description
app_description.hint: Shown on the landing page and used as the meta description.

app_url.label: Site URL
app_url.hint: Public URL of the panel (no trailing /), used for subscription links, payment callbacks and email links.

tos_url.label: Terms of service URL
tos_url.hint: Linked on the sign-up page; hidden when empty.

currency.label: Currency code
currency.hint: ISO 4217 code such as CNY or USD.

default_locale.label: Default language
default_locale.hint: Used for new visitors and emails.

show_info_to_user.label: Show node addresses to users
show_info_to_user.hint: When off, the user node list hides hosts and ports.

stop_register.label: Allow sign-ups
stop_register.hint: When off, new users can’t register. Existing accounts are unaffected.

email_verify.label: Email verification
email_verify.hint: Sign-up requires a code sent to the address. Codes go out by email: configure SMTP under “Email” and send a test message first.

email_whitelist_enable.label: Email domain allow-list
email_whitelist_enable.hint: Only the domains listed below may register.

email_whitelist_suffix.label: Allowed email domains
email_whitelist_suffix.hint: Press Return or comma to add; paste a list to add several. Shown under the email field on the sign-up page.

invite_force.label: Require an invite code
invite_force.hint: Sign-up needs a valid invite code.

register_limit_by_ip_enable.label: Limit sign-ups per IP
register_limit_by_ip_enable.hint: Caps how many accounts one IP can create within a time window.

register_limit_count.label: Sign-ups per IP
register_limit_count.hint: Accounts one IP may create per window.

password_limit_enable.label: Lock after failed logins
password_limit_enable.hint: Temporarily blocks sign-in after repeated wrong passwords.

try_out_plan_id.label: Trial plan
try_out_plan_id.hint: Plan granted to new users on sign-up.

captcha_provider.label: CAPTCHA
captcha_provider.hint: Protects sign-up, sign-in and email codes.

captcha_site_key.label: Site key
captcha_site_key.hint: Public key, sent to the browser.

captcha_secret.label: Secret key
captcha_secret.hint: Server-side key, never leaves the server.

subscribe_url.label: Subscription URLs
subscribe_url.hint: Alternative subscription hosts; the first is shown by default. Empty uses the site URL.

plan_change_enable.label: Allow plan changes
plan_change_enable.hint: When off, users can only renew their current plan.

reset_traffic_method.label: Default traffic reset
reset_traffic_method.hint: Used when a plan does not set its own.

surplus_enable.label: Upgrade credit
surplus_enable.hint: Credits the remaining value of the current plan when switching plans.

show_info_to_server_enable.label: Show plan info in subscriptions
show_info_to_server_enable.hint: Adds remaining traffic and expiry entries to the node list.

show_protocol_to_server_enable.label: Show protocol in node names
show_protocol_to_server_enable.hint: Appends the protocol to node names in subscriptions.

ruleset_default_template.label: Default routing template
ruleset_default_template.hint: Rule template used when users have not customised theirs.

ruleset_mirror.label: Rule-set mirror
ruleset_mirror.hint: GitHub raw proxy prefix; empty means direct.

allow_user_rule_profile.label: Allow custom routing
allow_user_rule_profile.hint: When off, everyone uses the default template.

order_timeout_minutes.label: Order timeout
order_timeout_minutes.hint: Unpaid orders are cancelled after this time.

invite_commission.label: Commission rate
invite_commission.hint: Share of each payment credited to the inviter.

invite_gen_limit.label: Invite codes per user
invite_gen_limit.hint: Maximum invite codes a user can create.

invite_never_expire.label: Invite codes never expire
invite_never_expire.hint: When off, a code is consumed after one use.

commission_first_time_enable.label: First order only
commission_first_time_enable.hint: Commission only for the invitee’s first order.

withdraw_close_enable.label: Disable withdrawals
withdraw_close_enable.hint: Commission can only be moved to balance.

server_token.label: Server token
server_token.hint: Shared secret node backends (XrayR / V2bX / soga) use to connect.

server_pull_interval.label: Pull interval
server_pull_interval.hint: How often nodes fetch users and config.

server_push_interval.label: Push interval
server_push_interval.hint: How often nodes report traffic and status.

server_white_list.label: soga white list
server_white_list.hint: White-list rules sent to soga, one per entry.

frontend_customer_service_url.label: Customer service URL
frontend_customer_service_url.hint: Support link in the user area.

frontend_footer_html.label: Footer HTML
frontend_footer_html.hint: Sanitised and shown in the footer.

passkey_rp_id.label: Passkey RP ID
passkey_rp_id.hint: WebAuthn relying-party ID (a domain, no port). Empty = host of the site URL; passkeys never work on an IP address.

passkey_origins.label: Extra passkey origins
passkey_origins.hint: Other origins allowed to use passkeys (e.g. https://www.example.com). The site URL origin is always allowed.

admin_mfa_required.label: Require 2FA for administrators
admin_mfa_required.hint: When on, admins and staff without 2FA or a passkey cannot use the admin API.

mfa_issuer.label: Authenticator issuer
mfa_issuer.hint: Issuer name shown in authenticator apps. Empty = site name.

subscribe_age_optional.label: Allow opting out of encryption
subscribe_age_optional.hint: With age encryption on, adding ?age=0 to a subscription link still returns plaintext.

subscribe_age_strict.label: Strict encryption
subscribe_age_strict.hint: With encryption on, formats that can’t be age-encrypted are refused (406) instead of served in plaintext.

subscribe_leak_max_ips.label: Leak detection threshold
subscribe_leak_max_ips.hint: Triggers when one subscription is fetched from more distinct IPs (IPv6 per /64) within 24 hours; 0 = off.

telegram_bot_token.label: Bot token
telegram_bot_token.hint: From @BotFather. Leave empty to turn Telegram off.

telegram_webhook_secret.label: Webhook secret
telegram_webhook_secret.hint: Part of the webhook URL (16+ characters); set the webhook again after changing it.

telegram_admin_chat_ids.label: Admin chat IDs
telegram_admin_chat_ids.hint: Chats that get admin notifications: user or group IDs (groups are negative) or @channel. Press Return to add.

telegram_events.label: Events
telegram_events.hint: Selected events are sent to the admin chats above.

telegram_user_notify.label: User notifications
telegram_user_notify.hint: Users who linked Telegram get expiry and traffic reminders and subscription reset notices there.

telegram_discuss_link.label: Community link
telegram_discuss_link.hint: Telegram group link shown to users (optional).

geoip_enable.label: Show IP locations
geoip_enable.hint: Show the region and network of each IP in the subscription access log. The data is the CZ88 (纯真) IP database (about 27 MB, IPv4 only), kept in the data directory and checked for updates daily.

geoip_download_url.label: Database download URL
geoip_download_url.hint: Where qqwry.dat is downloaded from; by default the latest release of metowolf/qqwry.dat on GitHub. Use a mirror when the server cannot reach GitHub. Empty: no automatic download, only a file you put at data_dir/geoip/qqwry.dat is used.

geoip_version_url.label: Version file URL
geoip_version_url.hint: A version.json whose latest field holds the newest release (such as 20261021); nothing is downloaded while it is unchanged. Empty: every check downloads the whole file and compares checksums.

subscribe_leak_action.notify: Notify (email the user; Telegram to admins and the bound user)

server.regenerateHint: Once saved, the old token stops working: update every node backend (XrayR / V2bX / soga) or they will disconnect.
server.snippetsHint: Replace NodeID / node_id with the node’s ID from the Nodes page; the copy button includes the real token.

email.testUnsaved: Email settings have unsaved changes; the test uses the saved configuration.

leave.title: Leave this page?
leave.hint: You have unsaved settings; they will be lost.

inputs.addPlaceholder: Type and press Return or comma

urlList.empty: None configured; the site URL is used.
urlList.invalid: Enter a URL starting with http(s)://

rulesets.title: Rule sets
rulesets.help: The open-source rule-set catalog used for subscription routing. The tabs show the effective catalog after your custom overrides (read-only); replace or add entries by id under “Custom overrides”.
rulesets.builtinMeta: Built-in catalog generated on {date} · schema v{version}
rulesets.customHint: Same schema as the built-in catalog: sources merge by key, categories / templates / mirrors by id — an existing id replaces the built-in entry, a new id is appended. Applies to subscriptions generated after saving.

issues.root: The top level must be an object
issues.unknownKey: Unknown key “{detail}” (only sources, categories, templates, mirrors)
issues.badId: id “{detail}” may only contain lowercase letters, digits, - and _
issues.badGroupType: Invalid group type “{detail}” (select / url-test / fallback / load-balance)
issues.badPrefix: Mirror prefix “{detail}” must be an http(s) URL ending with /

form.categoryHint: Fill in the file name (name) or geosite / geoip names for each source that publishes the list; empty sources are skipped. To enable it in a template by default, override that template in the JSON too.
form.categoryIdHint: Stored in users’ routing profiles — never rename it later.
form.idInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter or digit
form.prefixInvalid: Enter an http(s) URL ending with /
form.targetHint: A policy group name, or DIRECT / REJECT.
form.orderHint: Lower matches first; put specific categories before broad ones.
form.rulesRequired: Fill in rules for at least one source
form.added: Added to the JSON — remember to save

captcha_provider.turnstile: Free, by Cloudflare — no image puzzles.

subscribe_leak_action.notify: Sends an alert; the user’s subscription keeps working.
subscribe_leak_action.rotate: Rotates the user’s token; the old link stops working immediately.

protection.title: Abuse protection
protection.help: Limits bulk sign-ups from one IP and temporarily locks an account after repeated wrong passwords, against brute-force attacks.

protection.title: Leak protection
protection.help: Users can turn on age encryption for their subscription; it can then only be decrypted by a client on the mihomo 1.19.27+ core holding their secret key. Leak detection counts the distinct IPs fetching one subscription within 24 hours.

geoip.title: IP locations
geoip.help: The data is the CZ88 (纯真) community IP database, published weekly by metowolf/qqwry.dat. IPv4 only: IPv6 addresses have no location.

register.logWarning: Email delivery is set to “log only”, so codes are not actually sent.

telegram.title: Connection
telegram.help: Save first, then send a test message or point the webhook at this site.
telegram.unsaved: Save the Telegram settings before testing.
telegram.chatInvalid: Enter a numeric chat ID or an @username
telegram.regenerateSecretHint: After saving, the old webhook URL stops working — set the webhook again.

mailTemplates.title: Email templates
mailTemplates.help: Customise the subject and body (Markdown) of every email the panel sends, separately for Chinese and English. Templates you haven't customised use the built-in text.
mailTemplates.unsupported: This server can't customise email templates yet
mailTemplates.unsupportedHint: Upgrade the GG Bond server to edit emails here.

verify_code.title: Verification code
verify_code.description: The code sent when someone signs up or resets a password.

remind_expire.title: Expiry reminder
remind_expire.description: Reminds users to renew before the subscription expires.

remind_traffic.title: Data usage alert
remind_traffic.description: Warns users when this cycle's data is nearly used up.

ticket_reply.title: Ticket reply
ticket_reply.description: Tells users that support replied to their ticket.

subscription_reset.title: Subscription reset
subscription_reset.description: Tells users that an administrator reset their subscription secret (UUID and token) and to sign in for the new link; it never contains the new link.

notify.title: General notice
notify.description: Bulk emails, subscription leak alerts and other notices.

fields.subject: Subject
fields.subjectHint: One line, up to 255 characters; the body's variables work here too, e.g. {{siteName}}.
fields.subjectTooLong: The subject can't be longer than {max} characters

mailTemplates.placeholdersHelp: Click a variable to insert it at the cursor; it is replaced with the real value when the email is sent (written like the {{siteName}} of notices and knowledge articles). Variables marked * are required in the body. The body is placed inside the site's standard email layout (logo, card and footer), so only write the card's content.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.help: Rendered with sample data, exactly as users receive it; links don't open in the preview.
preview.subject: Subject
preview.missingHint: The body must contain these variables before you can save.
preview.unknownHint: These aren't variables of this template: they show up literally and saving will be refused.

reset.title: Restore the default “{template}” template?
reset.hint: The custom {locale} subject and body will be deleted and the built-in template used again.

test.title: Send test email
test.hint: Sends what you are editing (unsaved changes included) with sample data, through the saved mail settings.
test.draftInvalid: The template has a problem, fix it first: {message}

leave.title: Discard unsaved changes?
leave.hint: This email template has unsaved changes. They will be lost if you leave.
leave.switchHint: Switching template or language discards the unsaved changes of this one.

geoip.updating: Downloading in the background; this refreshes when done.
